name: Frontline plc
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-27, SEC EDGAR https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/913290/000162828026021774/fro-20251231.htm), cover page: securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) are 'Ordinary Shares, Nominal Value $1.00 Per Share', trading symbol FRO, listed on the New York Stock Exchange — the NYSE security is the ordinary share itself (also listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange under the same symbol), not an ADS
ads_ratio.reason: DATA_GAP:ads_ratio — Frontline is not an ADS program representing multiple ordinary shares: the NYSE-traded security is the ordinary share itself, so per-ordinary-share figures are directly comparable to the traded FRO price with no scaling.

f_subtype_basis: sum of the last 3 fiscal years (the median window)
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-27, SEC EDGAR https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/913290/000162828026021774/fro-20251231.htm), cover page: securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) are 'Ordinary Shares, Nominal Value $1.00 Per Share', trading symbol FRO, listed on the New York Stock Exchange — the NYSE security is the ordinary share itself (also listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange under the same symbol), not an ADS) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2016 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass. F sub-type: no cash generation (OCF - capex is not positive).
